cases.name: list
cases.when: always -- a list of people renders its rows and offers nothing to act on; a control inside a row belongs to that row's action slot and carries its own pattern
cases.reason: The list is a labelled <ul> or <ol> and nothing more: it takes no focus, answers no key and holds no state. What a reader acts on is whatever the consumer projected into a row's action, which is that component's own binding rather than this one's.
